text: Remember that the recipient of all your actions is God. Whatever you do, usually you can understand which person is the recipient of your resources received from you, will also do something, and the addressee of his actions will also do something… It turns out that each of your actions resonates with an infinite and eternal echo, and there is no final recipient either in space or in time. That is, you interact with the infinite and eternal. You can call it God or any other name. Understanding this fills your actions with special meaning.
